name: Mohammed al-Muthlim (Lasombra, Sabbat Agent, "Leader" of the Crypt's Sons)

system.concept: Secret Sabbat Sleeper Agent Posing as Leader of the Crypt's Sons Anarch Gang
system.title: Leader of the Crypt's Sons
system.biography:
Background

Born Walter Johnson, Mohammed fell into gang life in New York, found and abandoned the Nation of Islam under the name Mohammed X, and was forcibly initiated into the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} as a War Party chief for the 1965 siege of Los Angeles, taking the name Mohammed al-Muthlim ("of the Darkness"). When the siege collapsed, Mohammed secretly betrayed and slaughtered his own War Party alongside blood-mad @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} defenders, earning a hero's welcome among the anarchs he had actually been sent to destroy. He has spent decades since building the Crypt's Sons, ostensibly an anarch gang but secretly a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} beachhead, slowly expanding his South Central Los Angeles barony while awaiting orders to move against the Free States.

Roleplaying Hints

Mohammed follows the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.nNkKkOwEHChVViI4]{Path of Power and the Inner Voice} and walks openly among the Free States' barons as a friendly, gracious peer, all while concealing his Sabbat loyalty and ambitions of becoming an archbishop or cardinal once Los Angeles falls. His only real fear is discovery by Jeremy MacNeil before he is ready. Through the Crypt's Sons he commands both the largest Kindred gang and one of the most powerful mortal street gangs in Los Angeles.
system.notes: Haven: a crypt in Inglewood Park Cemetery, plus havens scattered through his barony. Lieutenant: Henry "Slash" Taylor. True sire: Tarantine (@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}). Storyteller note: mechanically follows a Path of Enlightenment rather than Humanity; virtues renamed Callousness/Instincts/Morale in the source material and mapped onto Conscience/Self-Control/Courage fields above for system compatibility.

prototypeToken.name: Mohammed al-Muthlim (Lasombra, Sabbat Agent, "Leader" of the Crypt's Sons)

system.description: While standing in a naturally occurring shadow, spend two Blood Traits and win a Static Mental Challenge against a seven-Trait difficulty to shift your position up to 50 steps to another natural shadow within line of sight, carrying your clothes and possessions. Bringing along an unwilling companion or using the power to escape restraint requires an additional Willpower Trait and winning a Physical Challenge.
system.bloodCost: 2 Blood Traits (+1 Willpower for a companion)

system.description: Spend any number of Willpower Traits and concentrate for three turns to summon a billowing cloud of darkness in a 50-pace radius, placing the area under Shroud of Night. For each of the next three turns, everyone you wish to destroy in the area must win a Static Physical Challenge against the Willpower Traits you spent or take three Health Levels of aggravated damage. The cloud then collapses, and anyone who died within it vanishes entirely, leaving only belongings. The power cannot be invoked again that night.
system.duration: Three turns, then ends for the night

system.description: By winning a Mental Challenge while holding your victim's gaze, you can erase, alter, or implant up to fifteen minutes of memory per challenge, or question the subject to recall details they otherwise might not share.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: Over several consecutive nights of unrestricted access and repeated Mental Challenges, you can break down a victim's will entirely, turning them into a virtually mindless thrall who obeys you without need for further tests.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: You may make a single retest on any challenge of sheer physical strength, even against an opponent relying on stamina or speed to resist, at no cost.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

vtmlarp.source: Los Angeles by Night, Chapter Four: The Damned
